_source: Request side of the Higgsfield connector's tool definitions as served to the agent on 2026-10-01 (the bot runs these; the CLI writes the request file). Names, required keys and limits copied from the live schemas; descriptions shortened. Pricing re-checked 2026-11-20: generate_video no longer takes get_cost; estimate_video_cost / estimate_image_cost / estimate_audio_cost price a request with the generate tool's own params.

params.use_unlim: OMIT IT to let the server decide - if the caller holds an allowance the tool submits nothing and returns `unlim_choice`, the question to put to the user; answer by calling again with the same params plus this field.

medias_item.value: UUID from media_upload/media_import_url or job_id from a prior generation. Do not pass https:// URLs here.

generate_video.pricing: Price a request with estimate_video_cost; get_cost is not accepted here.
generate_video.transport_timeout: On a transport timeout the submission outcome may be unknown: do not automatically resubmit. Reuse returned job IDs and retry only after the original outcome is known.

params.duration: may be omitted (the model default applies)

medias_item.value: uploaded media IDs or completed job IDs, not raw URLs

estimate_video_cost.submits: nothing (no job, no widget); Higgsfield presets cannot be quoted; a quote does not validate that the request is ready to generate

medias_item.value: uploaded media IDs or completed job IDs, not raw URLs

estimate_image_cost.submits: nothing (no job, no widget); a quote does not validate that the request is ready to generate

medias_item.value: uploaded media IDs or completed job IDs, not raw URLs

estimate_audio_cost.submits: nothing (no job, no widget); a quote does not validate that the request is ready to generate

model_params_used_by_slop._note: model-specific keys (allowed by additional_properties) that the production seedance_2_5 requests used
